rules.instruction: When the description states that an item is passed on to a party who must then decide on it, and a separate step describes that party receiving the item before the decision: Model the receipt of the item by the deciding party as its own bpmn:task (or receiveTask if it waits for a message) placed on the sequence flow after the preceding registration or submission step and before the decision task. Do not omit this receipt step or merge it into the decision task, even when the description states it in a separate sentence or treats it as a consequence of the handover.
